title: Best Fashion Designers for Hire (2026): Sketches to Tech Packs
description: How to hire a fashion designer for clothing sketches, collections, tech packs or flats: deliverables, factories, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Freelance fashion designers create clothing designs from concept to production files: mood boards, sketches, technical flat drawings, tech packs with measurements and materials, and collection plans. A good designer understands both style and manufacturing. Projects go wrong when designs cannot be produced, tech packs miss key details, or the designer copies existing brands. This guide helps you get designs a factory can actually make.

faq.a: A document with flat drawings, measurements, materials, trims, colors and construction details that factories use to make samples.

faq.q: Do I need sketches or flats?
faq.a: Sketches show the look; flats show exact construction. Factories need flats and tech packs.

faq.q: Can the designer find a factory?
faq.a: Some can recommend manufacturers. Many focus on design only. Clarify.
Agree in writing that you own designs and files once paid.
Agree on revisions at each stage: concept, sketches and tech pack.
